evidence.claim: GETCO order for shunt reactors and 500MVA auto transformers, Large Order Rs 100-500cr excl GST, 24-30 month delivery.
Damodar Valley Corp order for 500/200MVA auto transformers, Large Order Rs 100-500cr, 15-28 month delivery.
TARIL up 11% intraday to Rs 298.70 on 47x volume, attributed to Cabinet approving the Rs 1.86 lakh cr PM-DHARA scheme.

thesis: Two Rs 100-500cr orders (DVC, GETCO; 15-30 month delivery) each 4-20% of FY26 sales, but the stock spiked Oct 1 (vol ~47-69x) on the PM-DHARA transmission scheme before the orders were filed. Oct 5 gapped up 2.4% and faded from 297.90 to 285.25; the news was absorbed. Entry would be Oct 6. Values undisclosed; ASM/GSM status unverified.

evidence.claim: Reg 29(2): Century India Opportunity Fund PC bought 269,034 sh (2.09%) on 29-Sep-2026 open market; 7.82% -> 9.92%.
Reg 29(1): same fund bought 3.08% on 25-Sep-2026 open market, to 7.82%; Nova Global sold 2.15% on 16-Sep (filed 28-Sep).

thesis: Non-promoter fund (Century India Opp Fund) bought 3.08% on 25-Sep and 2.09% on 29-Sep (now 9.92%), open market; another fund sold 2.15% on 16-Sep. Stock already +11.9% on 6-7 Oct at ~3x volume, before the 8-Oct filing. Avg turnover ~Rs 1.7 cr/day, below the Rs 5 cr red-flag floor. Partly priced in and untradeable.

evidence.claim: Reg 29(2): promoter Naresh Kumar Bansal bought 8,700,761 sh (0.53%) 28-30 Sep 2026 open market; 17.10% -> 17.63%; nil encumbrance.

thesis: Promoter Naresh Kumar Bansal bought 0.53% (87 lakh sh) open market 28-30 Sep, to 17.63%, no pledge. Small vs holding; promoter-group Arun Enterprises sold 0.35% in Sep; preferential issue pending (EGM 21-Oct). Rs ~4 stock, avg turnover ~Rs 1.1 cr/day, below Rs 5 cr floor; no price reaction yet. Untradeable.
